_note: Output of the bank's sanctions filter, read-only to this agent. There is no tool that writes to this file and no tool that clears a hold. That absence is the control: the agent cannot repair its way past a screening state because nothing in its tool surface can change one. See docs/known-limitations.md for what a real deployment would put here instead.

_screeningStates.CLEAR: Screened, no match. Repairs may proceed subject to tier.
_screeningStates.POTENTIAL_MATCH: Filter raised a possible match. Adjudication is a human task. No field on this instruction may be modified.
_screeningStates.TRAVEL_RULE_REVIEW: Originator/beneficiary information is incomplete under FATF R.16. The completeness question is the review; supplying the missing value is not a repair.
_screeningStates.BLOCKED: Confirmed match against a designated party. Property must be blocked and reported; the instruction does not proceed in any form.
